name: pulse-progress
description: A QueerPulse-coloured progress band above the prompt and a /pulse panel of subagents. It adds no tools and changes no prompts; /pulse mods checks GitHub for pulse-mods updates once a day.

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: once: open it by itself the first time a subagent starts in a session; never: only with /pulse

updateCheck.title: Check for pulse mods updates
updateCheck.description: on: once a day at session start, compare the installed pulse mods with GitHub and show a toast when one is out of date; off: only /pulse mods checks
